findings.problem: The design states the portfolio components barrel 'exports components, not types', but src/features/portfolio/components/index.ts already exports PortfolioSummaryProps and PositionRowProps. The conclusion (import ChartRange from the hook module, not the barrel) is still correct; only the justifying sentence is inaccurate.
findings.fix: Reword to: 'the barrel exports each component with its own props type; ChartRange lives in use-portfolio-history.ts and every consumer imports it from there, so it is not re-exported through the components barrel.'

findings.problem: The no_account copy matches use-place-order.ts ('We couldn't find your paper account. Please try again.') but diverges from use-run-simulation.ts, which maps the same code to a more actionable 'Make a trade first, then try again.' — the exact gated-but-account-less learner case §9 says can occur on the chart card. Copy choice, not a defect.
findings.fix: Optionally adopt the more actionable Stress Lab phrasing for no_account, since the backfill surfaces this code to a learner with no trades yet.
